# Contributing to the extension manual

Pull requests are welcome from anyone.

## Quick start

1. Fork `php/doc-extensions` and create a branch from `main`.
2. Edit the XML files of the extension, each of which lives in its own directory
   under `reference/`.
3. Build the manual locally with `make` to check that the XML is valid and renders
   as expected.
4. Open a pull request against `php/doc-extensions`.

Only the English documentation is maintained here. Per the RFC, existing
translations were not carried over from the main manual.

## Guidelines

For general guidance on the documentation format, see the
[contribution guidelines](https://doc.php.net/guide/contributing.md) and the
[documentation pipeline overview](https://github.com/php/doc-base/blob/master/docs/overview.md).

## Reporting a problem

Use the issue templates to
[report a bug or suggest an improvement](https://github.com/php/doc-extensions/issues/new/choose).
